state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the monthly mobile allowance for a regular employee using a private phone today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q2: What is the annual training budget for an employee in the security team today? (answer in EUR per year)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.

Integration smoke run (this instance only): start with one search with k=6 for the first question. If the result lists omitted passages, fetch one of them. Then answer normally.

passages.source: HB-58 §2 | Memo: annual training budget exceptions — Exception for employees in the security team | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-08-01
passages.text: For employees in the security team, the annual training budget is 2700 EUR per year instead of the standard amount. The learning team reviews the annual training budget once a year and announces changes in advance. Claims for the annual training budget are filed in the expense tool under 'Learning policy: training budget'.

passages.source: HB-72 §1 | Learning policy: training budget — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-08-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-46
passages.text: This version set the annual training budget for all employees. The learning team publishes worked examples of the annual training budget on the intranet. The learning team reviews the annual training budget once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-46 §4 | Learning policy: training budget — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-72
passages.text: Group exceptions to the annual training budget are published in HB-58. The learning team publishes worked examples of the annual training budget on the intranet. The learning team reviews the annual training budget once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-46 §2 | Learning policy: training budget — Standard annual training budget | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-72
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 1400 EUR per calendar year. The learning team publishes worked examples of the annual training budget on the intranet. Claims for the annual training budget are filed in the expense tool under 'Learning policy: training budget'.

passages.source: HB-58 §1 | Memo: annual training budget exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-08-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the annual training budget in HB-46. Claims for the annual training budget are filed in the expense tool under 'Learning policy: training budget'. Questions about the annual training budget go to the learning team, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-46 §3 | Learning policy: training budget — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-72
passages.text: For employees who hold a team-lead role, 400 EUR per year is added to the standard annual training budget. Managers confirm claims for the annual training budget before payment in the next payroll run. Questions about the annual training budget go to the learning team, who keeps the record of decisions.
